Lilyhub là công cụ giúp bạn nhập, tổ chứ: Lilyhub helps you import, organize, read and listen to content you have the right to access. You are responsible for ensuring your use complies with your rights and the source provider's rules.
Không sử dụng Lilyhub để vượt qua đăng n: Do not use Lilyhub to bypass sign-in, paywalls or access protections, or to redistribute content without authorization. Lily may decline a source if it cannot verify that content is public and complete.
Lily không lập danh mục, công khai hoặc: Lily does not catalog, publish or reshare content imported from websites. Users initiate each import for their personal libraries. Source information is kept so users can return to the original page.
Chủ website hoặc chủ thể quyền có thể yê: Website owners or rights holders may ask Lily to stop supporting imports from a domain. After verifying ownership or relevant rights, Lily may block the source, restrict access or request deletion of imported content in accordance with applicable rules.
Website bên thứ ba có thể thay đổi cấu t: Third-party websites may change their structure or cease operating. Lily tries to detect errors and avoid saving incomplete books, but cannot guarantee that every source will always be available.
Thư viện, nội dung truyện đã nhập, tiến: Your library, imported content, reading progress, notes and bookmarks are stored locally in your browser on your device, unless a sync feature is introduced and you explicitly enable it.
Khi kết nối LilyHub, Lilyhub gửi thông t: When connecting to LilyHub, Lilyhub sends sign-in information to LilyHub's authentication service and receives account, plan and expiry details. Lilyhub does not store passwords in your local library.
Khi nhập từ website, địa chỉ công khai c: When importing a website, public URLs may be sent through Lily's proxy server to retrieve content. Proxy responses are not used to create a public book repository; the proxy is configured not to cache content. Lily does not automatically send saved books, notes, highlights or search history when you contact support.
